explanation: Three times prayer is prohibited in Islam: 1. From sunrise until the sun rises (~15 mins after sunrise). 2. At solar zenith (zawal/istiwa) when the sun is at its highest point (~10 mins before Dhuhr). 3. When the sun dims before setting (~15 mins before Maghrib).
voluntaryPrayerExplanation: Voluntary prayers (nafl) and prostrations are prohibited during these three intervals according to authentic Hadith.
